info.title: HALO B08 evidence backend contract
info.description: What B08 built (docs/backend/plans/b08-evidence.md): evidence.read, GET /api/evidence (app/api/evidence/route.js), the recorded environmental history Patterns and Season compare check-ins with (components/expanded/WeekEvidence.tsx through useProductionHistory in components/production/WeekSources.tsx); the additive home_context of GET /api/profile (Ruling E20), from which the client takes the home context id the history is checked against (lib/frontend/production/home-scope.ts observeHome, used by components/production/ProductionApp.tsx); and the daily maxima recorder cron, GET|POST /api/cron/daily-maxima, whose answer is counts only. Version b08-2 (2026-10-25) ships evidence.read: ruling E25 is resolved by Vibhav's decision of 2026-10-25 to ship with the frontend's remount fix, so the app remounts only on a genuine home transition and keeps the last known home when a re-read omits home_context (YOUR_TODO.md Part 4 items 24 and 25). The schema is unchanged from b08-1. The recorder records from the day it first runs. The response schema follows the frontend's validator (WeekSources.tsx:8), which drops the whole snapshot and shows "History could not be verified." on one wrong field; test/contractsB08.test.mjs runs that validator, the real runtime and the screen's own decisions on every real answer. Every body is bare: none carries a top-level data key, which runtime.ts:149-153 would unwrap. No U+2014 anywhere. Nothing here is a deployment, a provider right or an approval claim, and nothing has run against a real Supabase project.

x-halo-rulings.E1: The history is built from public.daily_maxima only (migration 0025), written by the recorder from each completed day's hourly provider series. daily_scores (app-time observations and the onboarding backfill) is never read, relabelled or served.
x-halo-rulings.E7: Air and UV are recorded. Pollen and Outdoor mold are never recorded: every date carries value null with their reason.
x-halo-rulings.E10: version is the method version, daily-max-v1, on every row and on comparison.
x-halo-rulings.E11: comparison.context and every row's context is the caller's current home context id, read owner-scoped on the server; X-Halo-Home-Context is ignored. An earlier home's rows and another household's are never served.
x-halo-rulings.E12: No current home, or migration 0016 not applied: {rows: [], comparison: {context: null, basis: 'daily maximum', version: 'daily-max-v1'}, complete: true}, status 200. null is the only value that passes the client's context check for a client with no context id. It breaks the declared type context:string (WeekSources.tsx:4); Yogi is asked to widen it to string|null.
x-halo-rulings.E13: One row per date and factor, every date of the range, oldest first, factors in the order Air, UV, Pollen, Outdoor mold. A null value always carries a missing reason from one frozen table; a value is never 0 unless the source said 0.
x-halo-rulings.E14: Only the latest 84 days are served; older dates are null rows with "Outside the twelve-week history window". Nothing is purged: retention is undecided.
x-halo-rulings.E15: Query keys are exactly kind, from and to, each once; kind is history; from and to are real calendar dates, from <= to, at most 92 days inclusive. A to after today is accepted (its dates are null rows).
x-halo-rulings.E16: issued is 'Unknown' on every row: neither AirNow's hourly data nor Open-Meteo publishes an issue time, and retrieval time is never substituted. The screen prints "Issued Unknown." and "Latest issue: Unknown".
x-halo-rulings.E18: complete: true means nothing was withheld (the bounded range is read whole), not that every date has a value.
x-halo-rulings.E20: GET /api/profile adds home_context, the current home in the PATCH's shape, or null when there is none. A MISSING home_context key means migration 0016 is not applied or the context read failed (logged); the profile is still answered, and the client's context id is then null.
x-halo-rulings.E25: Resolved 2026-10-25 (Vibhav: ship with a remount fix). The frontend keys ConnectedApp on identity and a home scope epoch that rises only on a genuine home transition (another id, a known home going away, a first home where there was none, or the same id's revision rising with a different point). A first appearance of home_context that agrees with what was known, an in-place attribute save and a re-read that omits home_context keep the scope, its drafts and its runtime scope key; the runtime's homeContextId still follows the profile (lib/frontend/production/home-scope.ts).

get.summary: The recorded daily maxima of the caller's current home for a date range
get.description: Called by the real client as runtime.request('evidence.read',{kind:'history',from,to}) (WeekSources.tsx:6), which builds ?kind=history&from=...&to=... with URLSearchParams (runtime.ts:125-128). Patterns asks for today - 83 to today (WeekEvidence.tsx:31); Season asks for the season's first day to the earlier of its last day and today (WeekEvidence.tsx:43). No outbound network call is made. Headers: X-Request-Id on every answer, Cache-Control private, no-store on the 200.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first date, YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last date, inclusive, on or after from, at most 91 days after it.

parameters.name: X-Halo-Home-Context
parameters.description: Sent by the client on every private request (runtime.ts:132). Ignored (E11): the home is always the session's own current home.

200.description: The history snapshot, or the E12 body when the household has no current home (or 0016 is not applied).

400.description: validation_failed, before anything is read (not even the probe). field_errors: a missing key (required), an unknown key (unknown_field, named by its plain name or 'query', so caller text is never echoed), a repeated key (duplicate_field), kind other than history (unsupported_kind), a non-calendar date (invalid_date), from after to (range_inverted), a span over 92 days (range_too_large). The client shows "Check the highlighted information and try again."

500.description: Internal error (internal_error): any database error other than a missing 0025. Logged with the request id and the error's code only, never an id, a point or a row.

503.description: feature_unavailable, not retryable: migration 0025 is not applied (the probe daily_maxima_schema_version, or a table it made, is missing, or another version answers). Or auth_unavailable, retryable with Retry-After: the session service is down. The client shows "This service is unavailable. Try again later." with Retry history.

get.x-halo-client: lib/frontend/stage-api.ts getProfile, read by components/stage/StageSession.tsx; lib/frontend/production/home-scope.ts observeHome takes home_context.id for ProductionApp.tsx
get.summary: The household's profile, with the additive home_context (E20)
get.description: Only the B08 addition is documented strictly: home_context. The legacy keys are as they were (onboarded, onboarding_complete, profile, household, household_set, and unavailable with reason household_unavailable when the composition read failed). home_context is the current home in the PATCH's shape (lib/homeContext.js contextSummary; the b01 HomeContext schema), or null when the household has no current home. A missing key means migration 0016 is not applied or the context read failed (logged with the request id, no coordinates); the profile is still a 200, and the client's context id is then null, so its evidence check passes only the E12 body. The PATCH is unchanged.

500.description: The profile read failed (internal_error). A failed home context read alone is never a 500.

get.summary: Records the three most recent completed America/New_York days for every current home context
get.description: The recorder (lib/dailyMaximaRecorder.js runRecorder): one AirNow aq/data call per run, at most two Open-Meteo calls per distinct stored point, no other provider. Rows are written through record_daily_maxima, which never rewrites a valued or final row. The answer is counts only, never an id, a point or a value. Merged and running; independent of E25.

cronSecret.description: Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> (lib/cronAuth.js), as Vercel Cron sends it.

RequestId.description: The caller's x-request-id when it is well formed, else a fresh UUID. Error bodies carry the same value as request_id.

NoStore.description: private, no-store: the history describes the household's home.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds, at least 1, on the auth_unavailable 503 only.

CronUnauthorized.description: No or wrong CRON_SECRET. Nothing is read or fetched.

RecorderInternal.description: An unexpected database failure (internal_error), logged by its code only.

RecorderUnavailable.description: feature_unavailable, not retryable: migration 0025 is not applied. No provider is called.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The shared HALO error envelope (lib/apiErrors.js). The client reads none of it: runtime.ts:144 maps the status to a failure code and shows its own sentence.

PresentableText.description: Text the screen may render: no U+2014 (house rule) and no control characters.

MissingReason.description: The frozen table of lib/dailyMaxima.js MISSING (E13). The first four are the frontend's own phrases (week-evidence-preview.ts:33).

enum: Pollen has a daily forecast index, not a daily maximum.

anyOf.pattern: ^Recorded from \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\. Earlier days have no daily maximum\.$

HistoryRow.description: One date and factor (HistoryReading, week-evidence-preview.ts:7). The validator (WeekSources.tsx:8) checks date, factor, value, source, issued, version and context; the rest is the contract's.

value.description: Air an integer AQI, UV to 0.1. null when missing; Pollen and Outdoor mold always null (E7).

enum: Open-Meteo with the CAMS air quality model, modeled, not measured
Open-Meteo forecast model, modeled, not measured
source.description: From the stored source code, never upstream text (E17).

version.description: The stored row's method version; daily-max-v1 for every row today.

enum: Open-Meteo with the CAMS air quality model, modeled, not measured
Open-Meteo forecast model, modeled, not measured

HistorySnapshot.description: HistorySnapshot (WeekSources.tsx:4) as the server sends it. nextCursor is never sent (no caller pages). With context null the rows are empty (E12).

context.description: The current home context id, or null (E12).

RecorderRun.description: lib/dailyMaximaRecorder.js runRecorder's counts. contexts: current home contexts read; eligible: those with a day to record; outside: outside North Carolina's padded box or not NC; noPoint: no stored point; notYet: no day after recording_from and the home's first full day; upToDate: nothing left to record; deferred: contexts left for the next run by the budget or deadline; points: distinct stored points; pointsCalled: points given Open-Meteo calls; airnowCalls, openMeteoCalls: provider calls made; airnowFailed, forecastFailed, airQualityFailed: failed calls; rows: rows sent; inserted, updated, kept, skipped, refused: record_daily_maxima's answer; finalized: pending rows that left the window and were made final; batches, failedBatches: write batches; finishFailed: 1 when the counts could not be stored.
